subject.title: fix: preserve signed URL tool details

question: Should generated signed URLs remain available through a new non-display capability or artifact reference, while all tool-display surfaces continue to redact their signed query credentials?
rationale: The PR’s central goal conflicts with the current redaction contract: a signed URL may be useful to an agent but is also a bearer capability when copied into logs or transcript-visible display text.

options.title: Keep display redaction and add a safe retrieval path
options.body: Retain `redactToolDetail`-equivalent protection for every display surface and design a separate, bounded way for the agent to use generated assets.

options.title: Accept signed URL disclosure in tool displays
options.body: Treat signed URL query values as intentionally visible and document the resulting transcript/log exposure as an explicit security policy change.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if no secure non-display path can be agreed for signed asset retrieval.

recommendation.title: Keep display redaction and add a safe retrieval path
recommendation.body: Retain `redactToolDetail`-equivalent protection for every display surface and design a separate, bounded way for the agent to use generated assets.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the agents display boundary and its relationship to the repository-wide logging redaction contract.
